text.description_html:
Bommer BB5002-400-601, 4" x 4" x Square Corners Stainless Steel Hinge

Package includes one (2) complete hinges with matching finish stainless steel flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel button tip hinge pin. Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips.

Specifications: for Bommer BB5002-400 4" x 4" Stainless Hinge

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Black
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel, Removable
  • Dual Ball-Bearing: 2 Ball Bearings
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A5112 for Ball Bearing Hinges
  • Wood Screws: 4 ea. #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: 8 ea. #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Bommer BB5002-400 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold as a Pair (2 door hinges)
